guides.title: Guides
guides.description: The culture your need to know before attend socials
guides.item1_content: Please make sure to check in and complete payment at the front desk before entering the party.
guides.item2_content: Keep your body clean and your breath fresh to ensure a pleasant experience for your partner. You may use perfume, deodorant, a towel, and change clothes regularly.
guides.item3_content: Dance shoes can protect your feet and the dance floor, avoid injury or slipping.
guides.item4_content:
Before inviting your partner to dance, please ask them if they would like to dance together. Do not pull your partner into the dance floor by hand. If they decline, do not be offended, they may just want to rest. You can ask again after a few songs.
🙋 What if you turn down dancer A’s invitation for some reason, but then dancer B invites you?
👉 You can tell dancer B that you will wait for the next song, to show respect to dancer A (unless you simply don’t want to dance with A at all 😊).
guides.item5_content: Do not use excessive force or inappropriate leading techniques that may cause discomfort or injury to your partner.
guides.item6_content:
Keep an appropriate dancing space, avoid pushing, pulling, or touching sensitive areas such as the face, chest, or hips.
If you encounter something uncomfortable in the dance floor, please immediately inform the teacher or organizer for assistance.
guides.item7_content: Do not cut across the dance floor. Please walk around the edges to avoid disturbing other dancers.
guides.item8_content:
Keep a safe distance from dancers when recording.
Always ask for permission before using or sharing videos of others. If someone refuses, please respect their choice.
guides.item9_content: Be careful around the DJ booth, as equipment is sensitive. Avoid getting too close or touching anything.
guides.item10_content:
Social dancing is a place for dancers to relax and socialize. Please focus on enjoying the dance.
Avoid teaching or excessively commenting on your partner's dance in the dance floor, keep a light and happy atmosphere.

about.title: About
about.description: About the start of this website
about.content:
Hi, I’m Steve, a newbie who just joined the dance scene in September 2023🐔.
Back in January 2025, I was chatting with Eric Chen about if there's a  better way for newcomers to learn about the social dance scene — the culture, common issues, and how to handle them (since social dancing naturally comes with its own set of challenges 🙂). That’s when the idea for this website started.
As I was working on it, I realized that finding event info has always been a pain...so why not include that too? And before I knew it, the site turned into what it is now.
I hope this guide helps the Latin social dance community in Taiwan grow. If you have any feedback, feel free to let me know, I really appreciate it! And if you’d like to support me, you can also donate me to help cover the hosting costs 🥹. Thanks in advance!
